_comment: Copy to deploy.config.json and fill in real wallet addresses before running. Amounts are in whole QVLT (the script adds 9 decimals). Months are 30-day periods.
notes: Fair Launch (40% / 400M) and Liquidity (7% / 70M) stay in the treasury and are moved at launch via withdraw_treasury (to seed & lock the Raydium pool).
DAO Treasury (15% / 150M) stays under treasury/DAO control.
